summary: Klamath NF enclosed-tower lookout, a secondary site from 1924 and built 1933-34; removed 1974, only the foundation remains; current access not documented.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on an enclosed timber tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1974; the register says only the foundation remains

staffing.status: Diary entry records a trip to install someone named Hayes on the lookout in June 1933

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Klamath National Forest

visit.trail_note: A third-party peak listing says a trail leads to the summit; no Forest Service source here confirms it

events.note: Secondary lookout site used until 1933, with a canvas fly, alidade and telephone and no cabin
Diary entry: tent and supplies moved to Deadwood to install Hayes on the lookout
Register gives 1934 for the cabin on the enclosed tower; a November 1933 newspaper note says the new lookout house was being built then
Register and Forest Lookouts list removal in 1974; the register says only the foundation remains
